summary: Added path: string[] to all /search results. DAG-tier: hardcoded ["context_dep of task/<task_key>"]. RAG-tier graph nodes: BFS over undirected deps+context_deps adjacency map, max 2 hops, max 50 nodes visited, anchored to dagKeys ∪ {task_key}. Knowledge items: path via parent tkey. Empty array when no path found. All 57 existing tests pass.

subject: Path provenance: attach DAG edge path to each search result
description: In /search, augment each result object with a `path` array showing how it connects back to the anchor task (for DAG-tier hits) or its closest graph neighbors (for RAG hits). E.g. ["task/17", "blocked_by:task/12", "context:note-X"]. This is free — the graph is already in memory during scoring. Consuming agents get structural explanation without re-querying. Also generates implicit trace data (which paths agents use/ignore) for future learned ranker training. Wire to decision note note-mqaaf1ox5pn as context.
